name: Bogey Esposito
source:
Bogey Esposito is part of the Hammer Gang, imaginatively named by the boss, [url=/c176875]Anthony "The Hammer" Tomasi[/url]. Bogey got his nickname when he was 19 working as a caddie at a gold club in town. A well-to-do dentist thought it would be fun to put Bogey in his place. Turned out, the dentist became one of his own best customers. Bogey got his walking papers, but earned the respect of several influential golfers. Bogey decided that he could use that putter in more creative ways than on the green.

[Edited from in-game description]
